name: Sofia
bbox_provenance: Derived 2026-08-28 from the network's own extent in gtfs_2026-08-27.zip (stops.txt + shapes.txt give lat 42.4788-42.8546, lon 23.0778-23.6075) plus a margin for GPS drift at the edges, not hand-picked; scripts/derive_bbox.py re-runs that derivation. The original hand-drawn box (lat 42.57-42.80, lon 23.15-23.55) was narrower than the real network on all four sides and silently discarded ~11% of routes serving peripheral settlements as teleportation artifacts. See METHODOLOGY.md.
feeds_provenance: Endpoints listed by urbandata.sofia.bg (Ниво 1 open data) and each confirmed live with collect.py --discover on 2026-08-27, all 200. Stored as whole URLs rather than a base plus a path template because CLAUDE.md section 7 forbids constructing a specific URL by pattern from a domain: these four are facts that were checked, not a shape that generalises.
speed_field_provenance: GTFS-RT specifies m/s and this feed's field arrives named speed_ms, but the values are km/h: whole numbers, median 17, p99 56, max 87, which as m/s would be a 61 km/h median and 313 km/h for a city bus (found 2026-08-31, named in METHODOLOGY.md). A spec-compliant feed must set this to "ms" — the conversion is not a project-wide constant.

attribution.licence_provenance: Read on 2026-09-22 from each feed's own dataset page, not from the portal's platform terms, because the terms are the fallback and three of the four feeds override them. gtfs-static, gtfs-trip-updates and gtfs-notices-warnings each carry rel="dc:rights" pointing at opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by-sa, labelled "Creative Commons Признание, Споделяне на споделеното"; gtfs-vehicle-positions states no licence and so falls under the platform's Общи условия v1.1 §5.1 default of CC BY 4.0. The portal names no version for the share-alike licence. 4.0 is derived, not assumed: the reference page the portal itself links states its domain of application as "Content, Data (latter 4.0 only)" and its overview links creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/, and only 4.0 carries the sui generis database clause that a data licence needs in the EU. That derivation is ours; a written answer from CGM Sofia would settle it, and until one arrives this field is the evidence, not the authority. "licence" is what this export publishes under: share-alike, because geometry.json, the segment keys and typical_weekday.json are all derived from shapes.txt.

known_limitations: The GTFS-RT feed carries no Sofia metro vehicles; this export describes surface transport only.
